**Indberetningsvejledning til Landspatientregisteret** is a guidance document that provides general instructions for correct data reporting to the Danish National Patient Register (LPR) [^src1]. It serves as a foundational reference for maintaining high data quality within the [[akut-kirurgi-databasen|Akut Kirurgi Databasen]] (Acute Surgery Database) [^src1].

Within the broader context of the Danish healthcare system's quality development program, the Akut Kirurgi Databasen combines data from several national registries to assess the treatment quality for acute abdominal surgery patients [^src1]. The methodology behind this database relies heavily on technical and administrative accuracy, encompassing data privacy, uncertainty measurement via confidence intervals, and the proper registration of patient data [^src1]. Because the database's quantitative indicator results depend on broad data integration, correct reporting to the LPR—as outlined in the *Indberetningsvejledning til Landspatientregisteret*—is essential for valid cross-sectional clinical quality measurement [^src1]. 

The document is explicitly referenced in the methodology section of the 2024 Akut Kirurgi Databasen report, where readers and data contributors are directed to it for general guidance on LPR reporting procedures [^src1].
